note: Machine settings a sample may carry (sample.machine). The block has one status (value_status: measured = recorded at the machine, or generated). tag_key is the short key on the NFC tag (docs/TAG_FORMAT.md). Our wording. Proposals awaiting review.

terms.label: machine
terms.definition: The kind of machine, such as v-bed flat.

terms.label: gauge
terms.definition: Needles per inch (25.4 mm) on one bed.

terms.label: loop length
terms.definition: Length of yarn in one loop of the main yarn.

terms.label: carriage speed
terms.definition: Speed of the carriage while knitting.

terms.label: needles in work
terms.definition: Needles knitting across the sample on one bed.

terms.label: program
terms.definition: File name of the knitting program.
